summary: GigaCloud Technology Inc filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to disclose that an affiliated entity of CEO Larry Lei Wu intends to enter into a prepaid variable forward contract (PVFC), pledging up to 700,000 Class A ordinary shares (~9.5% of Wu's beneficial ownership, ~1.9% total outstanding). The PVFC, expected to close by June 29, 2026, with a ~3-year tenor, is for liquidity/diversification, with Wu retaining capped upside (or full upside if cash-settled) and stating no intent to sell shares for 12 months post-execution. This is a routine insider hedging disclosure, not a special-situation event like a capital return or restructuring.
